texts: On day 410 of Year 2, a gust of wind extinguished a lantern on the Middle Row in the evening.
Marra Tallowhand saw the gust from her station.
Marra Tallowhand walked to the lantern.
Marra Tallowhand relit the lantern within the hour.
The lantern was away from the Sunken Cove.
The Council recorded the incident as a minor weather event.
Marra Tallowhand recommended that the Council issue extra mire-essence to the wind-exposed lanterns of the Cliff Path.
The Council took the recommendation under advisement.

q1_issues.issue: "No wraith emerged" is encoded as a single-witness strength-0 bundle with no (QuantifierPhrase wraith emerge "no") companion, so the explicit quantifier is read as plain "not" - the instruction set makes the companion mandatory for every explicit quantifier word precisely so the two 0.0 readings stay distinct, and routes "no N V" to the strength-0.0 distributing rule rather than one witness.

(Member sk_extinguish_1 weather_event) asserts at top level the classification that the text only says the Council recorded, dropping the "recorded ... as" attribution; Core patterns forbids letting an unencodable qualifier become an unqualified assertion.
(Member sk_extinguish_1 minor) has the same problem - "minor" is what the Council's record says of the incident, not an asserted property of the extinguishing event.

(Implication (PartOf $x sk_lanterns_1) (Member $x wind_exposed)) is a predication drawn from inside the sealed recommendation but emitted at top level, asserting of the real lanterns what only the recommendation's restrictive modifier states.

(To wind_exposed wind) supplies a preposition the text never uses - a noun-modifier compound licenses the genus only, and the head must be the preposition actually used (the sensitive_to_light pattern had an overt "to").

(Possession sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) is a possessor link stated only inside the seal; the seal-projection table lets exactly Member/Name typing, definitional decomposition and a factive's P out of an attitude seal, and says a referent's possessor / Of links stay sealed.

(Location sk_extinguish_1 middle_row) attaches "on the Middle Row" to the extinguishing event, but the PP more naturally restricts "a lantern" - the entity-attached (On sk_lantern_1 middle_row) - and the passage later trades on where the lantern is.

q2_gaps: Forward bounded-window temporal adverbial ("relit the lantern within the hour") - WithinLast is explicitly a backward window, Measure duration would claim the relighting lasted an hour, and BeforeBy states an exact gap, so there is no carrier for "no more than an hour after"; the parse correctly dropped it.

Object secondary predication "V NP as NP/AP" ("recorded the incident as a minor weather event") - not a resultative (nothing changes), not a depictive, not a finite-clause attitude; no head is given for the "as"-classification nor for attributing it to the record rather than to the world.

Mandative / directive subjunctive that-complement ("recommended that the Council issue extra mire-essence") - Directive / Forbid is imperative-only, and routing it through the ordinary attitude seal records a bare proposition and loses the directive force of the recommendation.

Episodic existential denial "No N V-ed" on a single occasion - the negated-verbal-generic machinery covers a generic habit ("owls don't migrate") and a definite set ("none of the Ns"), but not a one-off non-occurrence, where a strength-0.0 kind rule would over-generalize and a witness denial under-claims.

Portion / quantity of a bare mass ("a gust of wind") - the measure of-phrase is named only as an exclusion from the genitive rule, so (Member sk_gust_1 wind) is an improvisation by analogy with the mass-partitive rule.
Ordinal day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ("on day 410 of Year 2") - the Time terms assume a Month plus day-of-month, so (Day 410) has no well-defined reading.
review.notes: The heaviest losses are in the final recommendation, where three atoms drawn from inside the seal (the wind-exposed distribution rule, the To argument, the Cliff Path possessor) sit at top level, and in the "recorded as" clause, whose classification is asserted as fact. AwayFrom and take_under_advisement are both correctly formed under the multi-word-preposition and fixed-idiom conventions, and "within the hour" was rightly left unencoded.

issues.reason: An episodic one-off "No N V-ed" is uncovered territory (the reviewer's own q2 gap concedes it), and the parse's strength-0 witness bundle is exactly the licensed "A cooper does not caulk the barrel" shape with nothing false asserted, whereas the proposed strength-0.0 distributing rule would assert a generic about wraiths the text never states; the QuantifierPhrase companion is barred here by its own guard that it "only ever restates a range the rule itself quantifies - never a range that appears nowhere else in the parse".

Core patterns forbids an unencodable qualifier becoming an unqualified assertion, and the "is considered to be unstable" precedent bars a reported classification from reaching top level, so (Member sk_extinguish_1 weather_event) asserts as fact what the text only says the Council recorded.
Same falsehood: (Member sk_extinguish_1 minor) asserts a property of the extinguishing event that the text attributes only to the Council's record, dropping the "recorded ... as" qualifier.

Propositional attitudes states that P's full normalized form - "including a plural's per-member (Implication (PartOf $x <group>) ...) distribution rule" - goes INSIDE the sealed (And ...), and the projection table lets only Member/Name typing, definitional decomposition and a factive's P out, so a top-level rule over a non-factive recommend asserts wind-exposure of the real lanterns.

The (To <compound> <arg>) argument atom is licensed only for an adjective fused with an OVERT prepositional complement ("sensitive to light"), while Compound concepts says a noun modifier is "never exposed, whatever it names ... leave those in the symbol" and the oblique head must be "the preposition actually used" - "wind-exposed" uses none.

The seal-projection table says in terms that "a referent's possessor / Of links stated only inside P stay sealed", so the of-phrase link (Possession sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path), stated only inside the recommendation, must not sit at top level.

Thematic roles license Location for an event PP headed by "in/at/on", so attaching "on the Middle Row" to the extinguishing is a licensed reading; the NP-attachment alternative is at most an equally coherent site and the emitted atom is true under either, so a naturalness preference is not a rule violation.

gaps_confirmed: Forward bounded-window temporal adverbial ("within the hour"): WithinLast is backward-only, (Measure e duration ...) would claim the relighting lasted an hour, and BeforeBy states an exact gap - no carrier exists, and the parse rightly dropped it.

Object secondary predication "V NP as NP/AP" ("recorded the incident as a minor weather event"): no head is given for the as-classification, and no way to attribute it to the record rather than to the world.

Mandative / subjunctive that-complement ("recommended that the Council issue ..."): recommend is on neither the non-factive nor the factive list and Directive/Forbid is imperative-only, so the routing and the directive force are improvised.
Episodic existential denial "No N V-ed" on a single occasion: the negated-verbal-generic machinery covers a generic habit and a definite set ("none of the Ns"), not a one-off non-occurrence.
Quantity-of-mass NP ("a gust of wind"): the measure of-phrase is named only as an exclusion from the genitive rule and never given a positive encoding.
Day-of-year ordinal date ("day 410 of Year 2"): (Day n) is defined as a day-of-month term composing with Month/Year, so it has no well-defined reading here.
new_gaps: A restrictive DESCRIPTIVE modifier on a definite plural inside a seal ("the wind-exposed lanterns of the Cliff Path"): the projection table projects only Member/Name typing and P's per-member distribution rule must stay sealed, so the property identifying WHICH lanterns are meant has no projecting carrier at all - a licensed form would need either a projecting restrictor on the group symbol or a fusing classifier kind for the modifier.

Noun + participle compound adjective ("wind-exposed"): Compound concepts gives a genus rule for a noun head and explicitly leaves adjective/condition compounds opaque "for now", so even (Inheritance wind_exposed exposed) is unsettled, and with the sensitive_to_light argument atom requiring an overt preposition the noun modifier's relation has no licensed exposure - a licensed form would need a way to carry "exposed to what" without inventing a preposition.
adjudication.defect_summary: The "recorded ... as" classification has no licensed carrier, so the compliant form keeps the record event with (Theme sk_record_1 sk_extinguish_1) and leaves (Member sk_extinguish_1 weather_event) and (Member sk_extinguish_1 minor) out entirely, recording the gap - the same verdict for both confirmed atoms. The wind-exposed per-member distribution rule belongs inside the recommend seal's (And ...) as a conjunct with fresh variables, not at top level. "wind-exposed" takes at most its genus atom with the noun modifier left inside the symbol - no (To wind_exposed wind). (Possession sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) likewise belongs inside the sealed (And ...).
adjudication.notes: AwayFrom, take_under_advisement, Experiencer on the sealing recommend, and the dropped "within the hour" all follow the instruction set. The heaviest real loss is the seal leak in the final sentence, where three of P's own atoms sit at top level over a non-factive verb.
